_meta.source: MOE PSE pages (aggregate types, 3 year Higher Nitec score types), MOE Polytechnic Aggregate Types Computation table for the 2026 JAE, MOE PFP eligibility page and PFP cluster list from AY2027, MOE CourseFinder course pages, individual JC subject combination pages
_meta.notes: Every family here is provisional: the 2028 course lists and minimum entry requirements are due on MOE SchoolFinder and CourseFinder in mid 2027. Polytechnic and PFP subject lists were read in full from MOE's own 2026 JAE table and its PFP pages on 2026-11-11, so they are MOE's lists for the cohort before this one. The one row confirmed for 2028 is that course type B counts only Mathematics or Additional Mathematics as R1. JC needs come from individual college pages; MOE publishes no common H2 requirement. ITE examples are 2026 CourseFinder entries where marked, and otherwise not rechecked. Shown only when a student turns course families on.

poly.name: ELR2B2 A: mostly business, humanities and media courses

needs.text: R1 is an arts, business or Humanities subject. Examples: Art, Economics, Geography, History, Literature, Music, Humanities (Social Studies, Geography).

R2 is a second subject from that list, or one of these. Mathematics, Additional Mathematics, Mother Tongue, Design and Technology, Nutrition and Food Science, Principles of Accounts. No science counts.

poly.basis: MOE's Polytechnic Aggregate Types Computation table for the 2026 JAE. The 2028 lists arrive in mid 2027.

poly.name: ELR2B2 B: business courses with Mathematics, such as Accountancy

needs.text: R1 is Mathematics or Additional Mathematics. MOE states this for 2028.
R2 is an arts, business or Humanities subject. Examples: Principles of Accounts, Economics, Geography, History, Literature, Art, Music, Humanities (Social Studies, History).

poly.basis: MOE's Polytechnic Aggregate Types Computation table for the 2026 JAE. The 2028 lists arrive in mid 2027.

poly.name: ELR2B2 C: engineering, IT, applied and health sciences, with Nursing

needs.text: R1 is Mathematics or Additional Mathematics.
R2 is a science or technology subject. A Science, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Computing, Design and Technology, Nutrition and Food Science and Electronics all count.

poly.basis: MOE's Polytechnic Aggregate Types Computation table for the 2026 JAE. The 2028 lists arrive in mid 2027.

poly.name: ELR2B2 D: design and architecture courses

needs.text: R1 is Mathematics or Additional Mathematics.
R2 is Art, Higher Art, Design and Technology, Computing, Electronics, Nutrition and Food Science, or a science subject.

poly.basis: MOE's Polytechnic Aggregate Types Computation table for the 2026 JAE. The 2028 lists arrive in mid 2027.

pfp.name: Sciences cluster

needs.text: One relevant subject at G2 grade 3 or better. The current list names Design and Technology, Nutrition and Food Science and the three combined Sciences. Physics, Chemistry and Biology are assumed to count; confirm in mid 2027.
